name: datto-rmm-mcp
description: Every Datto RMM API operation, plus a local SQLite fleet store and fleet-wide analytics no other Datto tool has.

datto_rmm_api_key.title: DATTO_RMM_API_KEY
datto_rmm_api_key.description: Datto RMM API key (username in the OAuth password grant). Generate in Setup > Users in the Datto RMM web UI.

datto_rmm_api_secret_key.title: DATTO_RMM_API_SECRET_KEY
datto_rmm_api_secret_key.description: Datto RMM API secret key (password in the OAuth password grant).

datto_rmm_token.title: DATTO_RMM_TOKEN
datto_rmm_token.description: Optional pre-minted OAuth bearer token; when set, nothing is minted.

datto_rmm_base_url.title: Datto RMM API base URL
datto_rmm_base_url.description: Full API base URL, e.g. https://merlot-api.centrastage.net/api. Overrides the platform shortcut above. Leave blank when you set the platform.

datto_rmm_platform.title: Datto RMM platform
datto_rmm_platform.description: Regional platform shortcut that selects the API host: pinotage, merlot, concord, vidal, zinfandel, or syrah. It is the 'merlot' in merlot-api.centrastage.net. Leave blank if you set the base URL directly.

datto_rmm_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
datto_rmm_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of caching one in credentials.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

datto_rmm_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
datto_rmm_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

datto_rmm_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
datto_rmm_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

datto_rmm_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
datto_rmm_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (32 characters or more). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

datto_rmm_user_agent.title: Datto RMM User-Agent override
datto_rmm_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent header the connector sends. Leave blank for the default.
